name: Sicilian Dragon — Yugoslav Attack
description: The Dragon is one of the sharpest openings in chess. Black fianchettoes the bishop on g7, creating the 'Dragon bishop' — a long-range monster on the h8-a1 diagonal. White responds with the Yugoslav Attack: Be3, f3, Qd2, and O-O-O. The stage is set for one of the most explosive races in chess theory — White storms the kingside, Black counterattacks on the queenside.

lines.name: Dragon Variation — Yugoslav Attack
lines.description: After 5...g6, Black fianchettoes with Bg7, building the Dragon bishop on g7. White plays the Yugoslav Attack with Be3, f3, Qd2, and O-O-O — the most critical test. After 8...Nc6, both sides have declared their intentions: White will storm the kingside with g4-g5-h5, Black will counterattack with ...d5, ...a5-a4, and ...Rxc3. This is chess at its most savage.
